title: Paloma Rewards Redemption Values and Options by Tier
content:
Paloma Rewards points are worth a fixed USD amount per redemption block, and the tier decides which redemption options are open and how much Paloma adds to a charity donation.

| Tier | Redemption block (points) | Cash back per block (USD) | Charity donation open | Donation per block (USD) | Paloma's matching share of a donation | Airtime credit open | Airtime credit per block (USD value) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | 500 | 5.00 | Yes | 5.00 | 0% | No | 5.50 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | 500 | 5.00 | Yes | 5.00 | 0% | Yes | 5.50 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | 500 | 5.00 | Yes | 5.00 | 10% | Yes | 5.50 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | 100 | 1.00 | Yes | 1.00 | 10% | Yes | 1.10 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | 100 | 1.00 | Yes | 1.00 | 25% | Yes | 1.10 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | 100 | 1.00 | Yes | 1.00 | 50% | Yes | 1.10 |

A charity donation is valued at the cash back figure per block; Paloma's matching share is a percentage of that donated USD value, added by Paloma on top of it.

## Reading the table

- Every tier is worth 1 cent per point in cash back and in donations: 5.00 USD per 500-point block, or 1.00 USD per 100-point block.
- Airtime credit is worth 1.1 cents per point (5.50 USD per 500-point block, or 1.10 USD per 100-point block), on every tier where the option is open; on Paloma Rewards Blue the airtime credit option is not open.
- Charity donations are open on every tier; Paloma adds a match only from Paloma Rewards Gold upward (0% on Blue and Silver).

## Hypothetical illustration

A member on Paloma Rewards Diamond donating 2000 points gives 20 blocks of 100, each worth 1.00 USD: a donation of 20.00 USD, to which Paloma adds 25% of 20.00 USD, that is 5.00 USD, for 25.00 USD reaching the partner charity in all.
